about: Extraction-audit decisions on predicate edges flagged by the name check (v1 or v2) or the FDA-panel check. Applied by scripts/build_graph.py (forebear/audit.py) into the edge's audit fields, never into the human review fields; a human review in the app overrides any of these. Rule used: the legal citation is the K-number, so an edge is an 'error' only when evidence shows that K-number identifies a different product (another FDA panel, or the cited device's own cached summary describes something else); 'variant' when the K-number plausibly identifies the named product (same manufacturer and product line, OCR damage, an FDA record name that differs, the name sits elsewhere on the page, or a cross-panel secondary predicate whose name matches); 'not_predicate' when the K-number is cited for a component, accessory, data platform or as a reference device; otherwise 'unresolved'. Evidence was read from the full cached page text (data/raw/summaries) and the cached openFDA records. See docs/EVIDENCE_QUALITY.md.

Agrees with the curated review in data/reviews.json.
